title.value: Hand lead-gen agency tasks to an agent instead of a VA

introduction.value: A lead-gen agency poster used ChatGPT agent mode for work they normally pay a VA to do, and asks how to set up agents for repeatable tasks.

method.value: The poster runs a lead-gen agency and said they tried ChatGPT agent mode after a YouTube video, then saw it handle some work they normally pay a VA to do. In the thread, they do not spell out the exact task flow; instead they ask how to make repeatable specialist setups, such as separate agents for ad copy, creative, competitor research, or a VA-style role, and whether that means agent mode, custom GPTs, or Claude projects.

outcome.value: The concrete outcome stated is only that ChatGPT agent mode handled some existing VA work well enough to push them toward using agents for more tasks. No metrics, costs, or specific results are given, and the thread is mainly a request for setup advice rather than a documented workflow.
